name: keep
description: keep — the place work lives for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: keep
plugins.description: Puts the work queue in front of your agents instead of hoping they ask for it. Registers keep's ten MCP tools, and a SessionStart hook injects the ranked ready queue into context before the agent reads your first message — so it starts every session already knowing what is workable, what is blocked, and what is parked, without an instruction it can ignore. Adds /keep:ready, /keep:board, and /keep:file. Silent in repositories that have no store, so it costs nothing where it is not used. Requires the keep binary on PATH.
